---
title: "Join the section"
---

To join the section, login to the [CSEE members area](https://csee-scee.ca/members-area/) and edit your profile to add the Statistics section. Joining is free, but to support the activities of the section, we suggest that faculty members and professionals donate \$10 per year and that students and postdoctoral fellows donate \$5 per year. [Donate to the section](https://www.paypal.com/donate/?hosted_button_id=3PXNZ94UTP2AA)
